Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, production-quality 16:9 LANDSCAPE mobile game UI screenshot, ideally 1920x1080. Full-bleed artwork, NO device frame, NO presentation board, NO extra screens. Game: 桃园乱斗, funny chibi Three Kingdoms auto-battler. Image 1 is the exact playable Liu Bei character identity reference: giant ears, mischievous face, green robe, tiny bean feet, a straw sandal firmly GRIPPED in EACH fist, never normal legs. Image 2 is the actual item icon style reference; reuse those silhouettes/colors. These are reference assets, not a page to copy.
ART DIRECTION: a distinctive light Chinese comic-book camp interface. Warm ivory paper (#F7EBD1), dark ink-green (#243F37), forest green (#47714C), vermilion (#D6573D), copper-gold (#EABD64), small peach-pink accents. Thick confident dark-brown outlines, restrained offset hard shadows, very subtle paper grain, clean generous spacing, big readable modern rounded Chinese lettering. Expressive game art, NOT enterprise dashboard or generic web cards. NOT baroque brown fantasy UI, NO ornate gold filigree, NO glossy jewels, NO decorative tiny unreadable text, NO gradients everywhere. Background is an understated peach-orchard military camp at the screen edges with a canvas tent and a few peach branches, muted and low contrast; central UI very crisp. Consistent 48px outer safe margins; reserve the far upper-right area for the WeChat capsule without drawing the capsule. Typography and hierarchy must remain clear on a phone. All exact Chinese strings below must be legible and correctly spelled. No English headings or watermark. All shown controls are functional game controls; no editor annotations.
SCREEN: BETWEEN-ROUND LEVEL UPGRADE. Make a premium, playful composition with asymmetric character art at left (24% width) and THREE generously sized upright upgrade cards across the center/right (remaining 70%). The title "变强了！" is a bold, slightly angled comic brush-letter headline at upper left, with a small vermilion stamp accent (no stamp text). Small header line "第1关完成" and an understated step indicator "强化  ›  小铺  ›  出发", with 强化 active. Do not add another long subtitle.
Left below title: render the reference Liu Bei fully visible, proud silly expression, holding both straw sandals up, a small curved halo of peach petals and two simple celebratory ink marks. A neat small name tag underneath "刘备 lv.2". Keep this hero contained to left quarter, not behind the text cards.
Three main cards aligned at exactly the same baseline, with an ivory inner panel and dark ink edge, paper-tab top detail, slight offset shadow. One focused card (middle) has a green edge, subtle gold corner tick accent and 8px lift; other cards remain neutral. Distinct large expressive cartoon stat icons centered near top: first a chunky red heart with a cloth band; second a confident clenched fist with a small ink impact star; third a straw sandal with two short speed marks. These are ATTRIBUTE icons, not shop items.
CARD ONE exact hierarchy: small title "壮胆"; large "＋3"; medium "最大生命"; bottom comparison chip "11 → 14".
CARD TWO exact hierarchy: small title "巧劲"; large "＋1"; medium "武器伤害"; bottom comparison chip "6 → 7".
CARD THREE exact hierarchy: small title "手速"; large "＋5%"; medium "攻击速度"; bottom comparison chip "0.44s → 0.42s".
Strong large numerals are the visual focal point. Every card is a clear single-tap selection target; NO separate confirmation or continue button, NO repeated buttons under cards, NO shop currency, NO reroll, NO paragraphs. A single quiet bottom hint centered under cards reads "点击卡片，立即强化". In bottom-left a tiny calm note "剩余 1 次". Keep bottom area airy; this is a reward moment, not a spreadsheet. Cards occupy around y=240..880, with icon and number areas large enough to read in real gameplay. Beautiful, cohesive 2D game art, meticulous alignment, not a wireframe.

SCREEN: BETWEEN-ROUND ITEM SHOP, same design family as the upgrade screen. Warm comic-camp shop with an understated moss-green cloth canopy edge ONLY near top corners, a small knotted cord detail and a few peach petals. Clean ivory central composition. Top-left title "桃园小铺" in bold dark ink-green display lettering; small round marker "第1关完成". Across header an understated step indicator "强化  ›  小铺  ›  出发", with 小铺 active. Near top-right (but not far right safe zone) a distinct copper coin wallet pill with a square-hole coin icon and LARGE "45". No unnecessary help paragraphs.
LAYOUT: narrow left character/status column about 22% width; right merchandise area about 72% width with exactly FOUR equal tall item cards in ONE horizontal row. Comfortable gutters. Header y=65..185. Content y=245..820.
LEFT: label "刘备 lv.2", reference Liu Bei character around 260px tall, both fists gripping sandals, no long legs. Under character a clean compact green health strip with heart icon and "14 / 14". Under that a tidy 2x2 stat grid on unframed warm paper: "伤害 6", "护甲 0", "暴击 5%", "攻速 +0%". Hero is smaller than the merchandise area and must not dominate the screen.
ITEM CARDS: thick dark-brown outlines, off-white paper panels, small moss-green torn-paper tabs at top, large readable item illustrations from the reference sheet at upper half, item name, two simple stat lines, bottom purchase button with square-hole coin icon, price and "购买". Buttons are large forest-green rounded rectangles with cream text and a firm 4px dark offset shadow, not glossy.
Card 1 illustration woven straw insole, name "草编鞋垫", positive green lines "移速 +6%" and "拾取 +15", purchase label "12  购买".
Card 2 illustration tan bag of green mung beans, name "祖传绿豆", positive green lines "武器伤害 +1" and "射程 +15", purchase label "16  购买".
Card 3 illustration iron cooking pot worn as helmet with chin strap, name "铁锅头盔", green line "护甲 +2", muted vermilion negative line "移速 −3%", purchase label "20  购买".
Card 4 illustration steamed meat bun on a leaf, name "大肉包", green line "生命上限 +3", quiet smaller second line "同时回复 3 生命", purchase label "14  购买".
No rarity stars, no SALE badges, no invented item statistics.
BOTTOM CONTROL RAIL: a low contrast short inventory strip at bottom-left with satchel icon, label "行囊 · 0" and small empty-state text "买点宝贝再出发". Do not draw a fixed-capacity grid of empty slots. At bottom center-right a secondary ivory outline button "换一批" with a small coin icon and "3"; at far bottom-right a prominent vermilion primary departure button "第2关  出发 →". Exact alignment and generous tap targets. This primary button is distinct from green item-buy buttons. No bottom paragraph or eight-stat long sentence. All the necessary info should be comfortably readable on a landscape phone. Polished store UI with coherent character, icon and typography language, not a wireframe.
